text: {"lessons":["A few months of modest gains and losses are too little evidence to judge my strategy; avoid reacting to short-term noise.","With losses weighing more heavily on me, I should guard against fear-driven selling as well as complacency after gains, and make decisions based on risk and fundamentals.","Infrequent trading has kept me from making impulsive moves so far; I should continue to review diversification and risk periodically, trading only when there is a clear reason."]}
